commands.name: New-OfficeExcel
commands.synopsis: Creates a workbook from the theme and optionally fills it from a content block.
commands.notes: With a content block the workbook is saved and closed when the block ends (FileInfo with -PassThru); a block that throws saves nothing and removes the partial file. Without a block (Live set) the live ExcelDocument is returned and -Path is optional (Save-OfficeExcel -Path later). Saving fails if content would be lost unless -AllowLoss. Refuses to replace an existing file without -Force. -Template accepts .xltx/.xlsx/.xlsm (absorbs Copy-OfficeExcelWorkbook). -DocumentProperty takes Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Description, Category, Company, Manager, ApplicationName and LastModifiedBy keys. -MaxDegreeOfParallelism 1 forces sequential execution; the rest of the execution policy is the document's Execution property.

commands.name: Open-OfficeExcel
commands.synopsis: Opens an existing workbook, optionally editing it in a content block.
commands.notes: Replaces Get-OfficeExcel. With a content block the workbook is saved to its own path and closed when the block ends (not with -ReadOnly, and a -Uri workbook is never written back; save it with Save-OfficeExcel -Path). Without a block the live document is returned. Opening never restyles the workbook.

commands.name: Save-OfficeExcel
commands.synopsis: Saves a live workbook to its own path or a new path.
commands.notes: Fails if content would be lost, as today; -AllowLoss accepts it. Save-time behavior (preflight cleanup, defined-name repair, Open XML validation, formula evaluation, recalculation flags) moves to -SaveOptions (New-OfficeExcelSaveOptions or a hashtable).

commands.name: Close-OfficeExcel
commands.synopsis: Closes a live workbook without saving.
commands.notes: Closing never saves; pipe through Save-OfficeExcel -PassThru first. No -WhatIf because nothing is written.

commands.name: New-OfficeExcelSaveOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates save options for New-, Open-, Save- and Export-OfficeExcel.
commands.notes: Replaces the eight save switches repeated on New-, Save-, Close- and Export-OfficeExcel. -SaveOptions also accepts a hashtable with the same keys.

commands.name: Import-OfficeExcel
commands.synopsis: Reads rows from a worksheet, range or table as objects.
commands.notes: Absorbs Get-OfficeExcelData, Get-OfficeExcelRange and Get-OfficeExcelUsedRange. -Sheet takes a name, 1-based position or object, and * (or any wildcard) imports several sheets with a WorksheetName property on each row (replaces -AllSheets). Without -Range the used range is read; -Range takes an A1 range, a whole-row/column range (5:200, B:F) or a single top-left cell (A5) meaning from there to the end of the used range (replaces -StartRow/-EndRow/-StartColumn/-EndColumn). -As Object (default), Hashtable, DataTable, DataReader or Column replaces the four mutually exclusive switches. Writes a warning when the process runs in globalization-invariant mode and -Culture parsing would be affected (absorbs Get-OfficeExcelRuntimePreflight).

commands.name: Export-OfficeExcel
commands.synopsis: Writes pipeline objects to a styled, themed Excel table; -Path is the file it creates.
commands.notes: Defaults on: theme table style, frozen header row, fitted columns, number formats inferred from the data (dates, integers, decimals, currency-looking values); -NoTableStyle, -NoFreeze, -NoAutoFit turn each off and -NoTable writes a plain range. Creating a file uses the streaming writer with bounded memory; -Append and -ReplaceSheet open the existing workbook with the object model. A DataSet input writes one sheet per DataTable (sheet and table names from the DataTable). With -Append, -Table names an existing table to extend (replaces -AppendToTable); otherwise rows go after the used range. -ColumnFormat maps headers to presets (Text, Number, Integer, Percent, Currency, Date, DateTime) or format codes, with optional per-entry Decimals and IncludeHeader keys; it replaces the seven -*Column array parameters. -Address is the top-left cell (replaces -StartRow/-StartColumn). -FlattenOptions carries the nested-value settings (DictionaryEntrySeparator, DictionaryKeyValueSeparator, MaxCollectionItems, MaxNestingDepth, IncludeUnreadableProperties, PropertyConversionErrorAction). Default behavior replaces an existing file; -NoClobber refuses. Also absorbs Import-OfficeExcelDelimitedText through Import-OfficeCsv | Export-OfficeExcel.

commands.name: Edit-OfficeExcelRow
commands.synopsis: Runs a script block against each editable row of a range and writes the changes back.
commands.notes: Path and LiteralPath save in place; Document leaves saving to the caller.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelSheet
commands.synopsis: Adds or reuses a worksheet and runs a content block inside it.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelSheet
commands.synopsis: Sets worksheet visibility, tab color and the active sheet.
commands.notes: Merges Set-OfficeExcelSheetVisibility, Set-OfficeExcelSheetTabColor and Set-OfficeExcelActiveSheet. -Visibility Visible | Hidden | VeryHidden. Inside an ExcelSheet block it targets the current sheet. No DSL alias: ExcelSheet belongs to Add-OfficeExcelSheet.

commands.name: Move-OfficeExcelSheet
commands.synopsis: Moves a worksheet to a new tab position.
commands.notes: -Position is 1-based like -Sheet (was a zero-based -Index).

commands.name: Copy-OfficeExcelSheet
commands.synopsis: Copies worksheets within a workbook or from another workbook.
commands.notes: -Source is another workbook as a path or ExcelDocument (replaces -SourcePath/-SourceDocument); without it the copy is within the target. -Sheet selects the source sheets (wildcards copy several, with -NamePrefix), which also covers merging a whole workbook into an open document (Join-OfficeExcelWorkbook -Document). -Path/-LiteralPath name the target workbook, saved in place.

commands.name: Merge-OfficeExcelSheet
commands.synopsis: Appends or merges rows from one worksheet into another.
commands.notes: Renamed from Join-OfficeExcelSheet. -Sheet is the target sheet; -Address is the target start cell (defaults to after the used range).

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelSheetView
commands.synopsis: Sets frozen panes, gridlines, direction, zoom and view mode for a worksheet.
commands.notes: Merges Set-OfficeExcelWorksheetView, Set-OfficeExcelFreeze and Set-OfficeExcelGridlines. Paired show/hide switches become one switch; -NoGridlines:$false shows gridlines again and -RightToLeft:$false restores left-to-right. -FreezeRows 0 -FreezeColumns 0 unfreezes.

commands.name: Get-OfficeExcelSheetView
commands.synopsis: Gets frozen panes, gridlines, direction, zoom and view mode for worksheets.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelCell
commands.synopsis: Sets a cell value, formula, rich text, number format or fill.
commands.notes: Absorbs Set-OfficeExcelFormula (-Formula) and Set-OfficeExcelRichText (a script block passed to -Value runs as a content block of ExcelText runs, replacing -Run hashtables). -Sheet also takes an ExcelSheet object (replaces -Worksheet). -Column takes a 1-based index or a column letter. -Value also accepts ExcelRichTextRun objects for rarely used run effects.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelText
commands.synopsis: Adds a styled rich-text run to the enclosing cell or comment.
commands.notes: Shared Text vocabulary (-Text -Bold -Italic -Strikethrough -Underline -Color -Font -Size). Excel rich-text runs cannot carry their own hyperlink, so there is no -Link; -VerticalAlignment gives superscript and subscript. -Size is in points.

commands.name: Get-OfficeExcelRichText
commands.synopsis: Gets the rich-text runs of a cell.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelRow
commands.synopsis: Writes values across a row and sets its height, visibility and style.
commands.notes: bool? parameters become switches; -Bold:$false clears bold and -Hidden:$false unhides. -Height takes ExcelColumnWidth: a bare number is points (Excel's native row unit) and a unit value such as 0.8cm is converted. Column arguments take an index or letter.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelColumn
commands.synopsis: Writes values down a column and sets its width, visibility, number format and style, by position or header.
commands.notes: Absorbs Set-OfficeExcelColumnStyleByHeader as the Header set. -Column takes a 1-based index or a letter (replaces -ColumnName). -Width takes ExcelColumnWidth: characters of the default font, or a length converted through it.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelRowGroup
commands.synopsis: Groups rows into a collapsible outline, or clears grouping.
commands.notes: -SummaryAbove replaces -SummaryBelow $false (summary rows below is Excel's default).

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelColumnGroup
commands.synopsis: Groups columns into a collapsible outline, or clears grouping.
commands.notes: Column arguments take an index or a letter (replaces the *ColumnName twins). -SummaryLeft replaces -SummaryRight $false.

commands.name: Invoke-OfficeExcelAutoFit
commands.synopsis: Fits column widths and row heights to their content.
commands.notes: Without -Column or -Row every column and row is fitted. -Column * fits all columns only, -Row * all rows only; lists fit the given indexes or letters (replaces -Columns, -Rows and -All).

commands.name: Invoke-OfficeExcelSort
commands.synopsis: Sorts the used range by one header or an ordered set of headers.

commands.name: Update-OfficeExcelText
commands.synopsis: Replaces text in cell values across a workbook, sheet or range.
commands.notes: -Pattern is a regular expression, as in Search-OfficeDocument and Select-String; -SimpleMatch matches literally (the old default). Inside a block, pass the live -Document. Path and LiteralPath save in place.

commands.name: Find-OfficeExcel
commands.synopsis: Finds cells whose values match a pattern in a workbook, sheet or range.
commands.notes: Returns live cell matches (Sheet, Address, Value) inside one workbook; Search-OfficeDocument searches many files. -Pattern is a regular expression unless -SimpleMatch; -Exact matches the whole cell text.

commands.name: Clear-OfficeExcelRange
commands.synopsis: Clears values, formulas, styles and range metadata from a range, a header column or whole sheets.
commands.notes: -PassThru returns the number of cells cleared. -Include Values, Formulas, Styles, Comments, Hyperlinks, DataValidations, ConditionalFormatting, Merges, Sparklines or All (default All) replaces the eleven switches. Without -Range the whole sheet is cleared; -Sheet * clears every sheet. Absorbs Clear-OfficeExcelConditionalFormatting and Clear-OfficeExcelDataValidation.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelTable
commands.synopsis: Writes objects as a styled Excel table on the current sheet.
commands.notes: Same defaults as Export-OfficeExcel: theme table style, frozen header, fitted columns, inferred number formats. A DataSet at workbook scope writes one sheet per DataTable (absorbs Add-OfficeExcelDataSet). -PassThru returns the ExcelTable, not a range string.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelTableRow
commands.synopsis: Appends rows to an existing Excel table.
commands.notes: -Table takes a table name or an ExcelTable object (replaces -TableName and the Table set). For a file, use Export-OfficeExcel -Append -Table.

commands.name: Get-OfficeExcelTable
commands.synopsis: Lists the tables defined in a workbook.
commands.notes: Rows of a table are read with Import-OfficeExcel -Table.

commands.name: Get-OfficeExcelTableStyle
commands.synopsis: Lists built-in table styles and their compatibility recommendations.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelAutoFilter
commands.synopsis: Adds an AutoFilter to a range and applies filter conditions.
commands.notes: Merges Add-OfficeExcelAutoFilter (Range set) and Set-OfficeExcelAutoFilter (Condition set).

commands.name: Clear-OfficeExcelAutoFilter
commands.synopsis: Removes the AutoFilter from a worksheet.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelChart
commands.synopsis: Adds a themed chart from a range, a table or pipeline data.
commands.notes: Shared Chart vocabulary (-InputObject -Category -Value -Type -Title). The Data set writes the rows into the sheet as a table and charts it. Absorbs Add-OfficeExcelDashboardChart (-Preset, -Style, -ColorStyle). -Address is the top-left anchor cell (replaces -Row/-Column); -Width/-Height take lengths (default 640x360 px). -Type uses the Core OfficeChartType; Excel-only variants (clustered, stacked, 100%) map to OfficeChartType members or an Excel subtype parameter decided in M2. Charts use the theme palette, sans-serif text and light gridlines.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelChart
commands.synopsis: Applies a built-in style and color preset to a chart.
commands.notes: Renamed from Set-OfficeExcelChartStyle; chart-level settings live here.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelChartAxis
commands.synopsis: Sets chart axis titles, number formats, scale and gridlines.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelChartDataLabel
commands.synopsis: Shows and styles chart data labels.
commands.notes: Renamed from Set-OfficeExcelChartDataLabels (singular noun). Font parameters use the shared Text names.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelChartLegend
commands.synopsis: Shows, hides, positions and styles the chart legend.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelChartSeries
commands.synopsis: Styles a chart series or one of its data points.
commands.notes: -Index and -Point are 1-based (were zero-based). Absorbs Set-OfficeExcelChartPoint through -Point. Series names match case-insensitively unless -CaseSensitive.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelChartTrendline
commands.synopsis: Adds or replaces a series trendline.
commands.notes: -Index is 1-based (was zero-based).

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelImage
commands.synopsis: Adds an image from a file, a URL or a visual, anchored to a cell or range.
commands.notes: Absorbs Add-OfficeExcelImageFromUrl (Url set) and Add-OfficeExcelVisual (Visual set: ChartForgeX artifacts, OfficeVisualSource, conversion results, SVG). -Address takes a cell (one-cell anchor) or a range such as A1:C15 (two-cell anchor; replaces -Range and -Row/-Column). Geometry takes lengths; without -Width/-Height/-Scale the image keeps its natural size.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelSparkline
commands.synopsis: Adds sparklines for a data range.
commands.notes: Colors default to the theme palette.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelPivotTable
commands.synopsis: Adds a pivot table built from a source range.
commands.notes: Each Show*/Hide*, Enable*/Disable*, X/NoX pair becomes one switch read through BoundParameters: -ShowHeaders:$false hides headers, -DataOnRows:$false puts data on columns, -RefreshOnOpen:$false writes the explicit off value. Omitted means Excel's default. -Range is the source range with headers, -Address the destination cell.

commands.name: Get-OfficeExcelPivotTable
commands.synopsis: Lists pivot tables in a workbook.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelSlicer
commands.synopsis: Adds slicer or timeline binding metadata for a pivot table or table.
commands.notes: Absorbs Add-OfficeExcelTimeline (-Timeline).

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelSubtotal
commands.synopsis: Adds grouped subtotal rows and outline levels to a data range.
commands.notes: Renamed from Add-OfficeExcelSubtotalSummary.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelConnection
commands.synopsis: Adds Power Query or connection metadata that Excel can own and refresh.
commands.notes: Merges Add-OfficeExcelPowerQueryMetadata (PowerQuery set) and Add-OfficeExcelPackageMetadata (Xml set). OfficeIMO stores the metadata; it never runs queries.

commands.name: Get-OfficeExcelDataModel
commands.synopsis: Reports connection, query-table, data-model and external-link parts in a workbook.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelRefreshOnOpen
commands.synopsis: Turns refresh-on-open on or off for pivot caches and connections.
commands.notes: -SavePivotSourceData:$false replaces -NoSavePivotSourceData.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelValidation
commands.synopsis: Adds a data validation rule to a range or a header column.
commands.notes: -Type List | WholeNumber | Decimal | Date | Time | TextLength | Formula replaces the seven Add-OfficeExcelValidation* commands; -Value/-SecondValue convert to the type (int, double, DateTime, TimeSpan). -NoBlank replaces -AllowBlank $false. Prompt and error text can be set here or later with Set-OfficeExcelValidation.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelValidation
commands.synopsis: Sets prompt and error messages on existing validation rules.
commands.notes: Renamed from Set-OfficeExcelDataValidationMessage.

commands.name: Get-OfficeExcelValidation
commands.synopsis: Gets data validation rules from worksheets.
commands.notes: Renamed from Get-OfficeExcelDataValidation. -Range and -Header are filters; when both are given, -Header wins.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelConditionalFormat
commands.synopsis: Adds a conditional format: a rule, color scale, data bar or icon set.
commands.notes: Replaces the four Add-OfficeExcelConditional* commands with rule, color-scale, data-bar and icon-set sets, each targeting a range, a header column or a pivot table. -MidColor adds a three-color scale (new; two colors as before when omitted). Colors default to theme roles (Success, Warning, Danger). -NoValue replaces -ShowValue $false.

commands.name: Get-OfficeExcelConditionalFormat
commands.synopsis: Gets conditional formatting rules from worksheets.
commands.notes: Renamed from Get-OfficeExcelConditionalFormatting to match the Add- noun.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelHyperlink
commands.synopsis: Links a cell, or every cell of a range or header column, to a URL or a place in the workbook.
commands.notes: Replaces seven link commands. Single cell: Url set (-DisplayMode Text | Url | Host | Smart absorbs Set-OfficeExcelHostHyperlink and Set-OfficeExcelSmartHyperlink) or Internal set (-TargetAddress also accepts "'Summary'!A1" or a defined name, replacing -Location). Bulk: UrlRange/UrlHeader (Set-OfficeExcelUrlLinks[ByHeader]) map each cell text to a URL; InternalRange/InternalHeader (Set-OfficeExcelInternalLinks[ByHeader], selected by -Internal) link cell text to sheets. Header sets search the used range unless -Table or -Range narrows them. -Address replaces -Row/-Column.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelComment
commands.synopsis: Adds a note or a threaded comment (or reply) to a cell.
commands.notes: Absorbs Add-OfficeExcelThreadedComment (-Threaded). -Address replaces -Row/-Column.

commands.name: Get-OfficeExcelComment
commands.synopsis: Gets notes and threaded comments that match a filter.
commands.notes: -Kind Note | Threaded | All (default All). Absorbs the comment listing of Get-OfficeExcelCommentAudit; its metadata issues (missing authors, orphaned replies) are reported by Test-OfficeDocument.

commands.name: Update-OfficeExcelComment
commands.synopsis: Replaces the text or author of notes that match a filter.
commands.notes: Rich replacement text is a content block of ExcelText runs (replaces -Run). -All is required when no filter is given.

commands.name: Remove-OfficeExcelComment
commands.synopsis: Removes notes from a cell or all notes that match a filter.
commands.notes: Absorbs Clear-OfficeExcelComment. -Range takes a cell or range (replaces -Address/-Row/-Column); -All is required when no filter is given.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelNamedRange
commands.synopsis: Creates or updates a defined name.
commands.notes: -Save is removed; the enclosing block or Save-OfficeExcel saves.

commands.name: Get-OfficeExcelNamedRange
commands.synopsis: Gets defined names from a workbook.

commands.name: Remove-OfficeExcelNamedRange
commands.synopsis: Removes a defined name.

commands.name: Rename-OfficeExcelNamedRange
commands.synopsis: Renames a defined name.

commands.name: Get-OfficeExcelFormula
commands.synopsis: Lists formulas with their references, functions, volatility and external links.
commands.notes: Renamed from Get-OfficeExcelFormulaAnalysis. Emits one record per formula cell; -Volatile and -External filter. Workbook totals come from Measure-Object or Get-OfficeDocumentInfo.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelPageSetup
commands.synopsis: Sets orientation, margins, scaling, print area and print titles, alone or from a print preset.
commands.notes: Merges Set-OfficeExcelPageSetup, Set-OfficeExcelMargins, Set-OfficeExcelOrientation, Set-OfficeExcelPrintArea, Set-OfficeExcelPrintTitles and Set-OfficeExcelPrintLayout. Margins take lengths (were inches). -RepeatRows 1:2 and -RepeatColumns A:B use Excel row/column syntax (replace the four First/Last parameters); -NoPrintTitles clears them. -Preset applies a layout first; explicit parameters override it.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelHeader
commands.synopsis: Sets the worksheet page header text and image.
commands.notes: Split from Set-OfficeExcelHeaderFooter to match the shared Header/Footer vocabulary. Section text keeps Excel codes such as &P and &N for page numbers.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelFooter
commands.synopsis: Sets the worksheet page footer text and image.
commands.notes: Split from Set-OfficeExcelHeaderFooter.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelPageBreak
commands.synopsis: Adds manual row or column page breaks.

commands.name: Get-OfficeExcelPageBreak
commands.synopsis: Gets manual page breaks.

commands.name: Remove-OfficeExcelPageBreak
commands.synopsis: Removes manual page breaks.
commands.notes: Renamed from Clear-OfficeExcelPageBreak: page breaks are items, so Remove is the verb.

commands.name: Protect-OfficeExcelSheet
commands.synopsis: Protects a worksheet and chooses what users may still do.
commands.notes: bool Allow* parameters become switches; selecting cells stays allowed unless -NoSelectLockedCells/-NoSelectUnlockedCells. No DSL alias (the alias rule gives ExcelSheet to Add-OfficeExcelSheet).

commands.name: Unprotect-OfficeExcelSheet
commands.synopsis: Removes worksheet protection.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelTheme
commands.synopsis: Applies an OfficeTheme or theme XML to a workbook.
commands.notes: -Theme takes a built-in name, an OfficeTheme or a template path and restyles cell styles, table styles and chart formats (ApplyTheme). -Theme Modern replaces -Default.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelDateSystem
commands.synopsis: Sets the workbook date system (1900 or 1904).

commands.name: Get-OfficeExcelDocumentProperty
commands.synopsis: Gets built-in, application and custom document properties.
commands.notes: -Kind BuiltIn | Application | Custom replaces the three filter switches.

commands.name: Set-OfficeExcelDocumentProperty
commands.synopsis: Sets a built-in, application or custom document property.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelTableOfContents
commands.synopsis: Adds or refreshes a table-of-contents sheet with links to every sheet.
commands.notes: -BackLinkAddress replaces -BackLinkRow/-BackLinkColumn.

commands.name: Invoke-OfficeExcelTemplate
commands.synopsis: Fills {{Marker}} placeholders, repeats template rows or sheets, and keeps or removes optional rows.
commands.notes: Merges Invoke-OfficeExcelTemplate, -TemplateRow, -TemplateSheet and -TemplateOptionalRow as parameter sets. A file is filled with New-OfficeExcel -Template or Open-OfficeExcel and a content block.

commands.name: Get-OfficeExcelTemplateMarker
commands.synopsis: Lists template markers and, with -Value, which are bound.

commands.name: Test-OfficeExcelTemplate
commands.synopsis: Tests whether supplied values bind every template marker.
commands.notes: Renamed from Test-OfficeExcelTemplateBinding. The report has a ToMarkdown() method (replaces -AsMarkdown).

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelReportSheet
commands.synopsis: Creates a report worksheet and lays out report blocks inside it.
commands.notes: The report builder (sheet.Report() in C#) takes its fonts, colors and spacing from the workbook theme; the fill colors override it.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelReportTitle
commands.synopsis: Adds the report title and subtitle.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelReportHeading
commands.synopsis: Adds a section heading to the report.
commands.notes: Renamed from Add-OfficeExcelReportSection to the shared Heading noun.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelReportParagraph
commands.synopsis: Adds a paragraph of text to the report.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelReportSpacer
commands.synopsis: Adds vertical space to the report.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelReportCallout
commands.synopsis: Adds a highlighted info, success, warning or error callout.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelReportKpi
commands.synopsis: Adds a row of KPI cards.
commands.notes: Renamed from Add-OfficeExcelReportKpiRow (one alias per noun, matching PptKpi).

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelReportLegend
commands.synopsis: Adds a legend table that explains values or colors.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelReportTable
commands.synopsis: Adds a titled, styled table to the report.

commands.name: Add-OfficeExcelReportChart
commands.synopsis: Adds a chart of a report table, using a dashboard preset or chart type.
commands.notes: New block that absorbs the chart half of New-OfficeExcelDashboard. Without -Table it charts the previous ExcelReportTable and places the chart beside it.

commands.name: Compare-OfficeExcelRange
commands.synopsis: Compares two worksheets or ranges cell by cell.
commands.notes: Reference/difference naming as in Compare-Object and Compare-OfficeDocument; without -DifferencePath/-DifferenceDocument both ranges come from the reference workbook. Whole-workbook comparison is Compare-OfficeDocument.

commands.name: Export-OfficeExcelGoogleSpreadsheet
commands.synopsis: Exports a workbook to Google Sheets, or returns the translation plan or request batch.
commands.notes: -Mode Export (default) | Plan | Batch replaces -PlanOnly and -AsBatch. Stays an Excel command: the target is an online service with a session, not a file conversion.

commands.name: Get-OfficeExcelNumberFormatPreset
commands.synopsis: Lists number format presets and their format codes.

commands.name: New-OfficeExcelPdfOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Excel-to-PDF settings for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Pdf.
commands.notes: Margins take lengths (were PDF points). -Sheet replaces -SheetName.

commands.name: New-OfficeExcelImageOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Excel rendering settings for Export-OfficeDocumentImage.
commands.notes: Merges New-OfficeExcelWorkbookImageOptions. Sheet, range and chart selection are -Sheet, -Range and -Chart on Export-OfficeDocumentImage. The two C# options types merge in M2.

commands.name: New-OfficeExcelOpenDocumentOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Excel-to-OpenDocument spreadsheet settings for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Ods.

commands.name: New-OfficeExcelTestOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Excel checks for Test-OfficeDocument: capability preflight and package validation.
commands.notes: Carries the Excel-only settings of Test-OfficeExcelWorkbook and Get-OfficeExcelPreflight. The report has ToMarkdown() and ThrowIfFailed().

commands.name: New-OfficeExcelRepairOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Excel repair settings for Repair-OfficeDocument.
commands.notes: -Area DefinedNames | Tables | SheetViews | PrintSettings | Drawings | Calculation (default all) replaces the six -Skip* switches of Repair-OfficeExcelWorkbook.

commands.name: New-OfficeExcelProtectionOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Excel-only protection settings for Protect-OfficeDocument.
commands.notes: Precomputed legacy hashes and the write-reservation user name; the restrictions themselves (Structure, Windows, ReadOnlyRecommended) are -Restriction values of Protect-OfficeDocument, and the password to modify is its -RestrictionPassword.

commands.name: New-OfficeExcelHtmlOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Excel-to-HTML settings for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Html.
commands.notes: Carries the settings of ConvertTo-OfficeExcelHtml. -Theme takes an OfficeTheme (replaces OfficeVisualThemeKind).

commands.name: New-OfficeExcelCompareOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates workbook comparison settings for Compare-OfficeDocument.
commands.notes: -Exclude Cells | CellStyles | NamedRanges | Tables | WorksheetMetadata | Comments replaces the six -Skip* switches of Compare-OfficeExcelWorkbook.

commands.name: New-OfficeExcelMergeOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates workbook merge settings for Merge-OfficeDocument.
commands.notes: Carries the settings of Join-OfficeExcelWorkbook.

map.reason: Lifecycle rules: -NoSave is removed (omit the block to keep the workbook open), -Force guards replacement, -Theme applies the design theme, and the ten metadata and eight save switches become -DocumentProperty and -SaveOptions.
Get- commands read content; opening a file for editing is Open-, which also takes a content block.
Save switches move to -SaveOptions; -DateSystem is a workbook setting (Set-OfficeExcelDateSystem), not a save option.
Close only closes. Saving has one command, Save-OfficeExcel; Close no longer needs -WhatIf because it writes nothing.
Four commands read rows; Import-OfficeExcel with -Sheet, -Range and -Table covers them.
Duplicate row reader; Import-OfficeExcel -Range reads an explicit range.
Duplicate row reader; Import-OfficeExcel reads the used range when -Range is omitted.

Runtime preflight is a diagnostic concept. The one condition it reports that affects users (globalization-invariant mode breaking culture-aware parsing) becomes a warning from Import-OfficeExcel and Export-OfficeExcel when it applies; framework and culture names are available from $PSVersionTable and Get-Culture.

Same command with clean parameter sets: styled table, frozen header, fitted columns and inferred number formats are now defaults (-NoTableStyle/-NoFreeze/-NoAutoFit), the seven -*Column arrays fold into -ColumnFormat, metadata and save switches into -DocumentProperty and -SaveOptions, nested-value tuning into -FlattenOptions. -AutoFitFormattedColumn and -BoldTopRow are covered by the defaults (every column is fitted and the header row uses the theme header style).

Reading delimited text is the CSV area's job (Import-OfficeCsv: delimiter detection, -Skip, typed columns, -Culture); Export-OfficeExcel writes it into a new or existing workbook, and Add-OfficeExcelTable into an open one. A whole-file CSV to XLSX conversion is Convert-OfficeDocument -To Xlsx.
Visibility, tab color and active sheet are properties of one worksheet; one Set- command covers them.
Tab color is a worksheet property set by Set-OfficeExcelSheet.
The active sheet is a worksheet property set by Set-OfficeExcelSheet -Active. Edit a file with Open-OfficeExcel -Path .\Book.xlsx { ... }.
-Index (zero-based) becomes -Position (1-based, like -Sheet). The -Path set is removed: Edit a file with Open-OfficeExcel -Path .\Book.xlsx { ... }.
One -Source parameter takes another workbook as a path or document; -Sheet and -Name follow the shared vocabulary.
Join- joins strings in PowerShell; combining rows from one sheet into another is Merge-.
Sheet is the noun everywhere; paired show/hide switches become one switch, and freeze and gridline settings join the view command.
Frozen panes are a sheet view setting.
Gridline visibility is a sheet view setting; Set-OfficeExcelWorksheetView already duplicated it.
Pairs with Set-OfficeExcelSheetView; Sheet is the noun everywhere.
-Worksheet merges into -Sheet, which takes a name, position or object.
Set-OfficeExcelCell already sets formulas with -Formula.
Styled runs are child commands (ExcelText) in a cell content block; -Run hashtables are removed by the shared DSL rules.
-Address replaces -Row/-Column; -Sheet replaces -Sheet/-SheetIndex.
bool? styling parameters become switches, -FontName becomes -Font, and -Height takes ExcelColumnWidth.

Passwords and restrictions are the cross-format Protect-OfficeDocument job. Workbook structure and window protection become -Restriction Structure, Windows (OfficeProtectionRestriction gains the Excel values Structure, Windows and ReadOnlyRecommended; this is Excel UI protection; -Encrypt is file encryption); a precomputed hash moves to New-OfficeExcelProtectionOptions. Sheet protection stays with Protect-OfficeExcelSheet.
Removing restrictions is the cross-format Unprotect-OfficeDocument with the Excel restriction kinds.

A write reservation is a document restriction, not a separate concept: the password to modify is -RestrictionPassword and the recommendation is -Restriction ReadOnlyRecommended; the user name and a precomputed hash go in New-OfficeExcelProtectionOptions.
Removing the write reservation (password to modify and read-only recommendation) is Unprotect-OfficeDocument -Restriction ReadOnlyRecommended.
Read-only recommendation and write reservation are protection facts reported by Get-OfficeDocumentInfo (Protection.ReadOnlyRecommended, Protection.WriteReservedBy, Protection.HasModifyPassword).
-Theme takes the shared OfficeTheme (name, object or template path); -Theme Modern replaces -Default. Edit a file with Open-OfficeExcel -Path .\Book.xlsx { ... }.
-DateSystem is the ExcelDateSystem enum instead of a validated string.
Three exclusive filter switches become -Kind.
Content commands take no -Path or -Open: Edit a file with Open-OfficeExcel -Path .\Book.xlsx { ... } -Show.

Execution policy is an internal concept. -MaxDegreeOfParallelism on New-/Open-OfficeExcel covers the user choice (1 = sequential); the threshold, validation, diagnostics and autofit-save settings stay available as properties of $workbook.Execution.

The streaming contract is an internal concept: Export-OfficeExcel now picks the streaming writer itself. The facts users read (worksheet and estimated cell counts) are Get-OfficeDocumentInfo properties.

Generic document info (sheet, table, chart, pivot, link and comment counts, active sheet, theme, date system) is Get-OfficeDocumentInfo; per-sheet details are always included and hidden by the format view, and the schema snapshot comes with -Detailed.

-Body becomes -Text and -WidthColumns becomes -Span, matching the shared DSL names.

A dashboard is a report sheet with a title, a table and a chart; the report family (ExcelReport... DSL) builds it on the theme, so the second dashboard layout engine goes. The report builder places the table and chart, so explicit row/column positions are no longer needed; leave out ExcelReportChart for a dashboard without a chart.

Validation is the cross-format Test-OfficeDocument, which never changes a file: the defined-name repair the old command could perform moves to Repair-OfficeDocument (New-OfficeExcelRepairOptions -Area DefinedNames), and -SkipOpenXmlValidation to New-OfficeExcelTestOptions -NoOpenXmlValidation. Excel workbook-doctor issues, including comment metadata issues, appear as OfficeDiagnostic entries.
Repair is the cross-format Repair-OfficeDocument; the six -Skip* switches become New-OfficeExcelRepairOptions -Area. With -Document the caller saves, so -NoSave is removed.

Capability preflight is a check, so it is Test-OfficeDocument with New-OfficeExcelTestOptions; the report's ToMarkdown() and ThrowIfFailed() replace -AsMarkdown and -ThrowOnFailure. Features in use are also on Get-OfficeDocumentInfo.
Accessibility checking is Test-OfficeDocument -Check Accessibility, the same for every format that supports it.
Reference/difference naming as in Compare-Object replaces Left/Right; whole-workbook comparison moves to Compare-OfficeDocument.
Whole-document comparison is the cross-format Compare-OfficeDocument; Excel-specific scope and limits move to New-OfficeExcelCompareOptions.

Combining workbooks into one file is the cross-format Merge-OfficeDocument, with sheet selection and naming in New-OfficeExcelMergeOptions. Merging into an open workbook is Copy-OfficeExcelSheet -Source.
Creating a workbook from a package or template while preserving its parts is New-OfficeExcel -Template; a byte-for-byte copy is Copy-Item.

File-to-file conversion is Convert-OfficeDocument -To Html; Excel HTML settings move to New-OfficeExcelHtmlOptions. -AsString returns the HTML text instead of a file (the old behavior without -OutputPath).

Legacy upgrades are Convert-OfficeDocument -To Excel; an .xls -OutputPath selects the legacy writer for the reverse direction. -AllowLossyLegacyConversion becomes -AllowLegacyImportLoss; outputs are replaced unless -NoClobber, so -Force is no longer needed.
Eight per-format image commands become Export-OfficeDocumentImage; -Sheet selects sheets and rendering limits stay in New-OfficeExcelImageOptions.
Range images are Export-OfficeDocumentImage -Sheet -Range; rendering settings stay in New-OfficeExcelImageOptions and the output is replaced unless -NoClobber.
Chart images are Export-OfficeDocumentImage -Sheet -Chart; rendering settings stay in New-OfficeExcelImageOptions and the output is replaced unless -NoClobber.
-Mode Plan | Batch replaces two mutually exclusive switches.

Absorbs the workbook image options; used with Export-OfficeDocumentImage -Options. Pixel limits are counts, named ...PixelCount.
